title: Benowitz builds receivers to intercept base transmissions
place_text: Kirtland Air Force Base, New Mexico

tellings.quote: he built apparently a setup and started listening to transmissions coming from the base,

plain: Greg Bishop, a researcher and author, tells on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels about Paul Bennewitz, a man living near Kirtland Air Force Base in Albuquerque, New Mexico, around 1979 to 1981. Bishop says Bennewitz apparently built his own receiving setup and started listening to transmissions coming from the base, which he believed were connected to UFOs.
